root_cause.text: The function get_queue_ids() returns NULL when usr_queue_id_array is NULL even when num_queues is non-zero, but its callers only check for IS_ERR() errors (which NULL is not), so they proceed to dereference the NULL pointer, causing a kernel panic.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the return value from NULL to ERR_PTR(-EINVAL) when num_queues is non-zero and usr_queue_id_array is NULL, as shown in the diff. The commit description explicitly states: "When usr_queue_id_array is NULL and num_queues is non-zero, get_queue_ids() returns NULL. The callers check only IS_ERR() on the return value; since IS_ERR(NULL) == false the check passes, and suspend_queues() calls q_array_invalidate() which immediately dereferences NULL."
